CREATE TABLE "public"."appointment" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" character(36),
  "departmentId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "doctorId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "durationMinutes" int4 DEFAULT 30 NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "patientId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "scheduledAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'booked' NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "updatedBy" character(36),
  "version" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "appointment_status_check_a8851325" CHECK ("status" IN ('booked', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'no_show'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."bed" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currentPatientId" character(36),
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "roomId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'available' NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "bed_status_check_b354a3db" CHECK ("status" IN ('available', 'occupied', 'maintenance', 'cleaning'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."department" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."doctorProfile" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "departmentId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "licenseNumber" text,
  "qualifications" text,
  "specialization" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."patient" (
  "address" text,
  "contactEmail" text,
  "contactPhone" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamptz,
  "dob" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "emergencyContactName" text,
  "emergencyContactPhone" text,
  "firstName" text NOT NULL,
  "gender" text,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "lastName" text NOT NULL,
  "mrn" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "patient_gender_check_f90b1c49" CHECK ("gender" IN ('male', 'female', 'other'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."role" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "permissions" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."room" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "wardId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."session" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "ipAddress" text,
  "revokedAt" timestamptz,
  "tokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  "userAgent" text,
  "userId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ward" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "departmentId" character(36),
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
